The '''Jedi Bomber''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bomber/Legends|bomber]] was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] which resembled the [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] due to its design and the fact that an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] was mounted in the middle of the bomber. However, the Jedi Bomber was able to accommodate two [[pilot]]s in the vessel. It was armed with warhead launchers on the tips of the wings.

==History==
Jedi bombers were in use during the early part of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. One was employed by a pair of Jedi as a transport to [[Battle on the Sedawan|investigate]] the ''[[Sedawan]]'' when it was attacked by [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]], and three bombers were flown into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] ''[[Devastation]]'' when three Jedi teams of two ([[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]) were sent to [[Battle on the Devastation|destroy]] it.

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi bomber appears in the the [[2008]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Jedi Alliance]]''. Players can unlock concept art of the bomber.
